lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Person of Interest,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: sorry to message so late.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Are my glasses in your room,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: by any chance?
There's a pair of glasses here I've never seen before.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Looks like I left them in your room after all.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: That's a relief.
Want me to bring them to you?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: It's all right. It's pretty late anyway.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: They're just my spare glasses,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: so it's not urgent.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I'll pick them up next time

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I come by your room.
You even carry a spare pair with you?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I keep one or two spare pairs on me,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: just in case they get damaged

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: or I lose them.
People don't usually go that far.
Pretty sure Neon doesn't either.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: It's something I'm particularly sensitive about.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Without my glasses,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: or rather, when I take them off...

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I get extremely anxious,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: to the point that

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I feel like I'm not myself anymore.
Can I see you without them?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: No,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I can't show you that.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: It's not appropriate for someone in Overseer.
What happens if I take them off?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: If you really wanted to take them off by force, I don't think I could stop you.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: But I trust you.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: You're not the kind of person

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: who'd force someone

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: to do something they dislike just out of curiosity.
You're really not giving me much to work with here.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I'm in the inspection unit for a reason.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Given the nature of my work,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I can't afford mistakes.
Then can I ask you one last thing?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Of course.
You sleep with your glasses on?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: No, I don't wear them to bed.
I see.
That's good to know.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Why does that sound like there's more to it?
Hey, I'm just kidding, haha.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I am glad we've gotten close enough

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: to joke around like this, Person of Interest...

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: But please keep it to a minimum.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: You almost gave me a heart attack.
All right, I'll tone it down.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I must have been a bit on edge earlier, so it's catching up with me now.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I'll turn in for the night.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Sorry for reaching out so late.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Please rest well, Person of Interest!
You too, Avistar.
